import csv
import hashlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path

before = 'sku,price\nA-01,10.00\nB-02,20.00\nC-03,30.00\n'
after = 'sku,price\nA-01,12.00\nB-02,25.00\nC-03,30.00\nC-03,35.00\n'
brief = 'Approve A-01 from 10.00 to 12.00. Keep B-02 unchanged. Confirm the correct C-03 row with the catalogue owner before importing.'
request = f'Fictional catalogue review request. Do not send.\n[BEFORE CSV]\n{before}[AFTER CSV]\n{after}[CHANGE BRIEF]\n{brief}\n'
normalized = request.replace('\r\n', '\n')
_, rest = normalized.split('[BEFORE CSV]\n', 1)
parsed_before, rest = rest.split('[AFTER CSV]\n', 1)
parsed_after, parsed_brief = rest.split('[CHANGE BRIEF]\n', 1)
rows = [list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(part))) for part in (parsed_before, parsed_after)]
checks = {'csv_round_trip': (parsed_before, parsed_after) == (before, after), 'approval_brief_round_trip': parsed_brief.rstrip('\n') == brief, 'combined_data_rows_within_20': sum(map(len, rows)) <= 20, 'approved_change_present': rows[1][0]['price'] == '12.00', 'unapproved_change_present': rows[1][1]['price'] != rows[0][1]['price'], 'duplicate_preserved_for_manual_resolution': sum(row['sku'] == 'C-03' for row in rows[1]) == 2}
report = {'fixture': 'synthetic inline request', 'request': request, 'request_sha256': hashlib.sha256(request.encode()).hexdigest(), 'data_rows': [len(part) for part in rows], 'utf8_bytes': len(request.encode()), 'checks': checks, 'all_pass': all(checks.values()), 'expected_report': {'A-01': 'keep the approved price of 12.00', 'B-02': 'correct to 20.00 under the change brief', 'C-03': 'resolve manually with the catalogue owner before importing'}, 'coverage': 'Offline plain-text round trip only. The format and combined row limit are proposed. The current public offer, exact private-cycle limits, checker behavior, actual mail handling and commercial outcomes are outside this check.'}
output = Path('products/services/catalogue-commissioned-review/inline-intake-test.json')
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
readback = json.loads(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
print(json.dumps({'artifact': str(output), 'checks': readback['checks'], 'all_pass': readback['all_pass']}))
